timeRule: If the lecture runs over time, drop optional slides first, in reverse order, then the optional extras. Never drop a think point (checkpoint, station or Your call) and never drop the assumption-change slide. Station and vote minutes are separate from slide minutes: a checkpoint slide keeps 1 minute to show its question, and its station adds 3 minutes. Say which optional slide was dropped and point students to its full explanation.
